newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Jan-Apr retail volume down 8.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Jan-Apr retail volume down 8.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The volume of Hungary's retail sales dropped 8.9 percent in the first four months of the year from January-April 1996,, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Tuesday.
HUNGARY RETAIL TRADE AND CATERING VOLUME (Yr/yr pct change)
HUNGARY RETAIL TRADE AND CATERING TURNOVER (Forint blns)
NOTE - The total volume of retail trade and catering rose one percent in April from May according to seasonally adjusted figures, continuing this year's rising trend, the KSH said.
However, in year-on-year terms, the volume dropped five percent in April as last year the purchases before the Easter holiday were in April, while this year they were in March, the KSH added.
The country's retail and catering turnover totalled 245 billion forints in April, up 11 percent year-on-year at nominal value but down five percent year-on-year, the KSH said.
Hungary's inflation ran at 18.6 percent in April.
